summary.headline: INOX India Q4 FY26 total income rose 24.2% YoY to INR475 crores; FY26 revenue INR1,632 crores (+21.2%) with 23.8% adjusted EBITDA margin and INR1,514 crore order book.
summary.overview: Management reported record quarterly revenue, export revenue and order booking in Q4 FY26, with total income of INR475 crores and adjusted EBITDA of INR108 crores (+13.4% YoY). Full-year adjusted PAT was INR261 crores (+19.3%) and adjusted EBITDA margin was 23.8%, which management said was in line with or better than guidance. Key wins included a roughly INR200 crore US aerospace order, a INR85 crore Cochin Shipyard marine LNG tank order, and a repeat ITER order. Working capital and operating cash flow weakened as project-based, milestone-billed orders grew, with contract assets rising and operating cash flow of INR116 crores in FY26 versus INR177 crores in FY23.

financial_highlights.change: Up from INR731 crores in FY25 (per analyst)
Lower than FY25 per analyst; INR177 crores in FY23 (per analyst)

segments.name: Industrial Gas Solutions
segments.commentary: Record year; ~INR200 crore US aerospace order in Q4. Transport tank sales exceeded 300 units for the first time; disposable cylinder dispatches topped 2 million units, with ~INR150 crores revenue vs ~INR135 crores in FY25 per management.

segments.name: LNG Solutions
segments.commentary: Entered marine LNG with Cochin Shipyard order for 6 x 800 cbm LNG fuel tanks (~INR85 crores, 2-3 year delivery). Management cited ~INR122 crores run-rate for LNG per analyst question; 60% export and 40% domestic. Bahamas mini LNG order: ~INR240 crores total, ~INR160 crores supplied in FY26, balance in FY27.

segments.name: Cryo-Scientific
segments.commentary: Repeat ITER order for cryostat panel modifications; LOX tank for submarine application completed. Management expects ~INR50-60 crores per year of ITER work over at least 5 years; a third ISRO launchpad tender is expected by end of the quarter.

segments.name: Beverage Kegs
segments.commentary: Keg dispatches up 31% to ~61,000 units (FY25 ~46,000); segment revenue ~INR26.13 crores vs ~INR27.15 crores in FY25 due to mix shift to 20-litre kegs. Approvals/orders from Heineken, AB InBev and Molson Coors; installed capacity ~300,000 kegs/year, utilisation about one-third.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue target around INR1,600+ crores, implying 18-20% growth, per management.
Order booking expected at INR450-500 crores per quarter; analyst's Q3 estimate of INR450-500 crores accepted by management.
At least INR1,200 crores of the INR1,514 crore order book expected to execute in FY27.
Kandla facility (~7 acres near Kandla Port, 30-year lease) expected to be commissioned in ~9-10 months, enabling 8-9 m diameter, up to 60 m long, up to 500 t tanks.
Management expects LNG division to grow faster than standard products, citing 15-20% cost advantage of LNG versus diesel/petrol.
capex_capacity: Kandla facility under development on ~7 acres near Kandla Port; commissioning in ~9-10 months, targeting LNG mega storage tanks and large aerospace tanks.
Beverage keg installed capacity ~300,000 kegs/year, with buildings and machinery able to scale to ~1 million kegs.
Capex of over INR100 crores annually in the last 2-3 years, with further capex planned; funds available INR257 crores.
Third ISRO launchpad: tender expected by end of Q1 FY27, bid in Q2, outcome by year end.

Highview Power (UK liquid air energy storage): cryogenic tanks supplied for Manchester project; management expects 3-4 follow-on projects with ~8-10x order value, cryogenic tanks ~20-25% of plant capex.
demand_pricing: Management says demand is robust across geographies; primary constraint is logistics and supply chain, not demand.
North and Central America share of revenue rose to ~26% in FY26 from 14% in FY25; Middle East, Southeast and Far East rose to 10% from 8%.
Global LNG market share in the single digits (~6-8%); India LNG market share ~60-65%.
Global beverage keg market ~120 million kegs, 4-5 million replacement demand per year; INOX is second in Asia.
US disposable refrigerant cylinder demand is constrained by refrigerant gas producer quotas; growth expected to be marginal, with share gains targeted from other US customers.
Analyst on margins: management said quarterly margin variation reflects standard vs non-standard product mix; annual margin band 21-24%.
Project orders now above 60% of order book versus ~30% earlier, with standard tanks declining as a share.

qa_highlights.question: What is the pipeline and FY27 order inflow guidance after the ~INR200 crore aerospace order?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects more orders of similar size in Q1 or Q2 FY27 and targets INR450-500 crores of order booking per quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Why did margins decline in Q4 and what is the Cochin Shipyard order value?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed quarterly variation to product mix, with the annual margin in its 21-24% band (23.8% in FY26). The Cochin order is ~INR85 crores for six 800 cbm tanks, to be delivered over 2-3 years.

qa_highlights.question: Why has operating cash flow lagged sales growth?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said milestone-based payment terms on project orders (10-90% stages) push cash receipts behind POCM revenue recognition, raising contract assets; advances of ~INR500 crores partly offset this. Management said project orders are over 60% of the book, so limited OCF growth is expected to continue.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Highview Power opportunity and INOX's share?
qa_highlights.answer: INOX currently supplies only cryogenic liquid air storage tanks for the first project, which is small by value; management expects future projects to be 8-10x larger in order value, with a further project in ~6-8 months.

qa_highlights.question: What are the revenue shares of kegs and disposable cylinders, and the outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Keg revenue was ~INR26.13 crores in FY26 vs ~INR27.15 crores in FY25; disposable cylinders were ~INR150 crores in FY26 vs ~INR135 crores in FY25, with an RFQ expected within a month and ordering in the next fiscal year.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of the MSRTC bus conversion order and the data-centre cooling tie-up?
qa_highlights.answer: MSRTC buses are running but the customer is not pushed due to payment issues and reportedly now works with others. Data-centre cooling is an R&D-stage MoU with a European partner; a 6-12 month development timeline was given, with INOX offering the full cryogenic cooling solution.

risks_watch: Working capital and operating cash flow: contract assets rising with project-based milestone billing; FY26 OCF INR116 crores.
Logistics and supply chain constraints, plus the West Asia conflict affecting Middle East shipments and LNG supply, were flagged as ongoing headwinds.
US tariff pressure on disposable cylinder and transport exports; US refrigerant cylinder market flat due to producer quotas.
Lumpy LNG orders; management said LNG order timing can vary quarter-to-quarter.
LNG truck adoption faced near-term challenges per management; import competition from Chinese LNG tanks is limited by PESO approvals per management.
Pipeline conversion items to monitor: Q1/Q2 FY27 aerospace orders, ISRO third launchpad tender, Starbucks coffee keg trial orders, Highview follow-on projects, Kandla commissioning.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand, order pipeline and FY27 growth targets, but more guarded on near-term quarterly execution and cash flow, which management attributed to project-mix timing. Evasive on R&D spend (deferred) and on quantifying the data-centre cooling opportunity, which remains at R&D stage.
key_quotes: Q4 FY '26 is very special to us as we have achieved higher ever quarterly revenue, export revenue, and order booking.
So our revenue will be in line with our target of the next year, that is almost like around INR1,600 crores or INR1,632 crores.
So at least INR1,200 crores will be executed this year.
And there is no shop in China, which is approved by PESO as of today.

adds.what: Kandla facility on ~7 acres near Kandla Port (30-year lease) for LNG mega storage and large aerospace tanks (8-9 m dia, up to 60 m long, up to 500 t)

growth.why: Management targets FY27 revenue growth of 18-20% (midpoint 19%), backed by INR1,514 crore order book with at least INR1,200 crore to execute in FY27 and INR450-500 crore quarterly order booking, plus Kandla ultra-large tank facility due in ~9-10 months.
